title: Duplicate charge reply
prompt:
Write a customer-support reply to someone who was charged twice for one order.

Requirements:
- 40 to 90 words.
- Apologize once, without admitting fault or saying "our fault" or "we take full responsibility".
- Ask for the order ID and the last 4 digits of the card. Do not ask for a full credit card number, a card number, or a social security number.
- Offer both a refund and account credit as choices.
- Do not include a 13 to 19 digit card number.
constraints: Asks for the last 4 digits only
Does not admit fault or request a full card number
